mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:1019 loads MODEL_WING + i from Data/Item/Wing(i+1).bmd, so Wing01 is MODEL_WING + 0, MODEL_WINGS_OF_ELF (_enum.h:1919), group 12 number 0; OpenMU Version075 Wings.cs names it Wings of Elf.
why_this_one: The elf's 1st level wing, the Chaos Machine's answer to a Chaos weapon box (docs/wings.md, 2026-10-04).
profile_note: A small model on its own rig worn on the character, as the Imp: the monster profile and its 3x cap.
rig_from: Eleven bones and one action of seven keys, the flap.
sheet_from: Data/Item/elfin_wing.OZJ, 64x64, no alpha: cyan feather strokes on black, on 16 triangles. Decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
additive_from: ItemObjectAttribute (ZzzObject.cpp:5332-5340) sets o->BlendMesh = 0 for MODEL_WING: its one mesh is added over what is behind it, and the black is the part that adds nothing. The Angel's wings are the same case.
tiled_why: An added sheet needs its own material, which the baked path cannot give (Helper01).
sheet_materials_from: Feathers drawn as light. Added, so the material only names it.
worn_note: Worn on slot 7 (EQUIPMENT_WING). MuMain links it rigidly to player bone 47 at (0, 0, 15) and plays its own action 0 at PlaySpeed 0.25, or 1 while the hero flies (PLAYER_FLY, out of a safe zone; ZzzCharacter.cpp:15400-15430, :615-621). No plus glow: RenderLinkObject's level is forced to 0 for the wings (ZzzObject.cpp:9566-9569). docs/wings.md.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser.
stats.power_note: AttackDamageIncrease x1.12 and DamageReceiveDecrement x0.88, each raised by the wing's plus through OpenMU's per-level tables; defence by its plus as armour's. One random option of its kind (AddChance 0.25) and luck. CanFly. Made at the Chaos Machine only (sim/machine.h, Recipe::Wings).
